name: BetterResourceManager
description: Better Resource Manager v0.1.0-alpha.3: Better Resource Hub with extensible CPU/GPU inputs and outputs, Auto allocation, and the Smart Thread / Smart GPU Managers from Adaptive Smart Manager test23.

godot.description_rich: Better Resource Manager adds Better Resource Hub, a single node that pools CPU and GPU from any number of inputs and distributes them to any number of outputs, and keeps the Smart Thread / Smart GPU Managers (window ids smart_thread_manager and smart_gpu_manager). Fork of Adaptive Smart Manager by guardipee14, itself based on kuuk / Omisse's Smart Manager (MIT).
